banned.title: Your account is banned
banned.body: Your 3Speak account has been banned, so you can’t be logged in. If you think this is a mistake, contact 3Speak support.

upload.title: Uploading is disabled for your account
upload.body: Your account isn’t allowed to upload right now. If you think this is a mistake, contact 3Speak support.

uploadBlock.bannerBody: You can still watch, comment and follow. Questions? Talk to us:

emergency.title: We’re having some infrastructure issues
emergency.body: Our team is working to bring 3Speak back right now. Join our Discord for live updates.

invite.title: <who>@{{referrer}}</who> invited you to 3Speak
invite.incubatingFastTrack: You can turn @{{handle}} into your own Hive account right now, without finishing the warm-up.
invite.incubatingKeepGoing: Keep going with your warm-up. @{{referrer}} is credited as the person who invited you.
invite.signUpFastTrack: Sign up and get your own Hive account right away: one login for 3Speak and every other Hive app, with keys only you hold. It takes about a minute.
invite.signUpFree: Sign up and start with a free profile on 3Speak. Your invite is saved, so @{{referrer}} gets the credit.
invite.lookAround: I just want to look around

interests.saved: Interests saved. Change them anytime in Settings
interests.title: What are you into?
interests.body: Pick a few topics you enjoy and we’ll show you more of the content you like. You can change these anytime in Settings.

postVideos.title: Post videos
postVideos.text: Long form video that stays yours

goLive.title: Go live
goLive.text: Bring guests on stage, keep the recording

buildCommunity.title: Build a community
buildCommunity.text: Start a space or join one

bookAds.title: Book ads across 3Speak
bookAds.text: Video spots, shorts spots, player banners, tickers and pre-upload spots, from one day to three months.

payFromWallet.title: Pay from your own wallet
payFromWallet.text: In HBD or HIVE, straight from this account. No card and no middleman.

chooseWhere.title: Choose where it runs
chooseWhere.text: Pick the format, the position in the video and how many days it runs.

seeDelivered.title: See what it delivered
seeDelivered.text: Plays and clicks for every booking, and credit back if a booking falls short.

talkToCustomers.title: Talk to your customers
talkToCustomers.text: If you want to: post videos, answer comments and follow people under your brand.

oneAccount.title: One account everywhere
oneAccount.text: The same brand and login across every Hive app, with a key only you hold.

welcome.profileLive: Your profile is live. Welcome to 3Speak!
welcome.brandProfileLive: Your brand profile is live. Welcome to 3Speak!
welcome.title: Welcome to 3Speak
welcome.advertiserReady: Your advertiser account @{{user}} is ready. This is the account you book ads with and pay from.
welcome.heyUser: Hey @{{user}}, you made it. 3Speak is built on Hive, so your account, your audience and your content belong to you.
welcome.noteAdvertiser: First, a quick look at your brand profile: it is what viewers see next to your ads.
welcome.note: One last thing before you start: let people know who they are watching.
welcome.profileTitle: Let people know who you are
welcome.brandProfileHint: Carried over from your warm-up. Saving puts it on your Hive account; you can change it any time.
welcome.profileHint: This is what people see on your profile. You can change it any time.
welcome.saveAndBook: Save and book my first ad
welcome.interestsHint: We use these to pick what shows up on your home page. Choose as many as you like, or none, and change them whenever you want.
welcome.interestsFineprint: Saved to your Hive account, so every Hive app shows the same profile and the same interests.
welcome.profileFineprint: Saved to your Hive account, so every Hive app shows the same profile.

profileEdit.title: Edit your profile
profileEdit.subtitle: Your picture, name and bio show on your profile and next to everything you post.
profileEdit.fineprint: Saved to your Hive account, so every Hive app shows the same profile.

profileFields.imageTooLarge: That image is over 8MB, please pick a smaller one
profileFields.bannerHint: Keep the important part centred: the sides crop on narrow screens and your name sits over the lower left.
profileFields.pictureHint: A face or a logo works best. Square, 400 × 400 px or larger. Up to 8MB.
profileFields.bioPlaceholder: What do you make, and what should people expect?
profileFields.locationPlaceholder: Where in the world are you?

auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired — please log in again
auth.loggedInViaButrauth: Logged in as @{{user}} via Butter Auth
